items.exampleEn: Seriously? You ate the whole cake?
items.exampleZh: 真的假的？你把整個蛋糕吃掉了？
items.glossZh: 認真地；嚴重地；（口語）真的假的

items.exampleEn: A phone is useful in many ways.
items.exampleZh: 手機在很多方面都很有用。

items.exampleEn: My friend has an unusual name.
Please use proper words when you write to your teacher.
items.exampleZh: 寫信給老師時，請用恰當的字詞。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother's eyes are weak, so she can't read small letters.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶視力不好，看不清楚小字。

items.exampleEn: This song is widely loved in Asia.
items.exampleZh: 這首歌在亞洲廣受喜愛。

items.exampleEn: We live on opposite sides of the river.
items.exampleZh: 我們分別住在河的兩岸。

items.exampleEn: The bear is the symbol of our school team.
items.exampleZh: 熊是我們學校球隊的標誌。

items.sentenceEn: This map is very useful for tourists.
items.sentenceZh: 這張地圖對觀光客很有用。

items.audioEn: The post office is opposite the bank.

items.sentenceEn: It's unusual to see snow in this city.
items.sentenceZh: 在這座城市看到下雪很少見。

items.stemEn: You need ____ shoes for hiking in the mountains.
items.stemZh: 在山上健行需要穿合適的鞋子。

items.stemEn: English is ____ used around the world.
items.stemZh: 英文在全世界被廣泛使用。

items.passageEn: Last summer, I traveled to Japan with a guidebook. It was very useful. In one small town, I saw an unusual red gate. The guidebook said the gate is a symbol of the town. English is not widely spoken there, so I learned some Japanese words. My Japanese is still weak, but people were kind. My hotel was opposite the station, so it was easy to find.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我帶著一本旅遊指南去日本旅行，它非常有用。在一個小鎮上，我看到一座特別的紅色大門。指南上說，這座大門是那個小鎮的象徵。那裡會說英文的人不多，所以我學了一些日文。我的日文還很弱，不過大家都很親切。我的飯店就在車站對面，很好找。

questions.questionZh: 那座紅色大門是什麼的象徵？

referenceEn: A heart is a symbol of love.
The heart is a symbol of love.
rubricZh: 「⋯的象徵」可寫例如 a symbol of love

items.instructionZh: 用 seriously 造一個句子，說說你認真看待的一件事。
referenceEn: I always think seriously about my future.
rubricZh: seriously 修飾動詞（例如 take … seriously、think seriously about）
take＋事物＋seriously 表示「認真看待」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：題目要說「你認真看待的一件事」，參考答案 Our coach talks to us seriously before every game. 主詞是教練、也不是『認真看待某事』，不符題目要求。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "I always think seriously about my future."（原 "Our coach talks to us seriously before every game."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：參考答案改寫，例子同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "seriously 修飾動詞（例如 take … seriously、think seriously about）"（原 "seriously 修飾動詞（例如 take … seriously、talk seriously）"）
